act.name: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing maternity leave, payment, nursing breaks, creche facilities and protection from dismissal.

sections.title: Right to payment of maternity benefit.
sections.text: Section 5 provides the statutory right to maternity benefit and governs the qualifying conditions and benefit period.
sections.plain_language_summary: Eligible women are entitled to paid maternity benefit for the period and on the conditions specified by the Act.

sections.title: Nursing breaks.
sections.text: Section 11 provides nursing breaks for a woman after returning to work following delivery.
sections.plain_language_summary: An eligible nursing mother is entitled to additional prescribed breaks during work.

sections.title: Creche facility.
sections.text: Section 11A provides for a creche facility in establishments covered by its conditions.
sections.plain_language_summary: Covered establishments must provide a creche and allow visits as specified by the Act.

sections.title: Dismissal during absence of pregnancy.
sections.text: Section 12 protects against dismissal or disadvantage in the circumstances covered during maternity absence.
sections.plain_language_summary: An employer cannot dismiss or disadvantage a woman merely because of protected maternity absence.
